name: transfer_dea_registration
description: transfer_dea_registration: Transfer a DEA registration to a new facility and state. The current registration remains active until the effective date, at which point the new facility and state take effect. Returns a case_id on success.

dea_number.description: The provider's DEA number. Format: 2 uppercase letters followed by 7 digits. Example: BK4729183

new_facility_code.description: The facility the DEA registration is being transferred to. This is the new facility, not the provider's current home facility. Format: 2-4 uppercase letters, dash, 2 digits, 1 letter. Example: BWH-02A

new_state_code.description: The 2-letter US state abbreviation for the new facility's location. Example: CA, NY, TX

transfer_reason.description: The reason for the transfer: facility_relocation (same role, moving to a different facility), role_change (new clinical role at a different facility), or additional_practice_site (adding a second location while keeping the original)

effective_date.description: The date the transfer takes effect in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-06-01
